text: {"rulings": [{"id": "1", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The schema being settled says nothing about which database engine is used; both can be true."}, {"id": "2", "relation": "supersedes", "reason": "The database was Postgres as of 6 Apr, but by 1 Jul it is SQLite; it cannot be both at once, so the Postgres claim is dead."}, {"id": "3", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Customs docs living in object storage rather than the database holds regardless of whether that database is SQLite or Postgres."}, {"id": "4", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The Node runtime version has nothing to do with the choice of database."}, {"id": "5", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Deployment to Fly.io and using SQLite are independent facts that can both be true."}]}
